amendment1_durationMatchedCadence.problem: the published horizons coincide only at 12 and 48 frames, so RECOVERED_BY_CADENCE cannot be assigned at 144, 360 or 720 without a continuous-hold control of the same duration
conditions: the same experimental adapter as the pulse train
the same pre-declared start states and the same independent starts
a neutral arm of equal duration and an alternative mask for every control
amendment1_durationMatchedCadence.frame720Rule: 720 is NOT passed to the standard Causal.probeAction, whose hard per-arm cap is 600. The control runs in the isolated adapter with neutral and alternative arms and is labelled explicitly as an independent implementation.

labelRules.RECOVERED_BY_CADENCE: requires a duration-matched continuous control showing the change absent
labelRules.RECOVERED_BY_DURATION: long versus short within the same regime
labelRules.CADENCE_UNDECIDABLE: no duration-matched control exists, so structure and duration cannot be separated

amendment2_addressTruncation.problemConfirmedInSource: agod-causal.js line 113 applies attributed.slice(0, limits.maxAddressesReported) inside evaluateStart, so aggregate() consumes already-truncated lists; the default is 64 and the CAP is 256
truncationControl: truncation is recorded when any reported list length equals the limit

a RAW MEMBERSHIP CHECK, independent of the causal verdict, asks whether the target address changed at all between the neutral and action arms; this is explicitly NOT a causal claim, only a check that the address could have been considered

newStatus.ADDRESS_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN: the probe report was truncated AND the candidate's membership in the full set is not established
newStatus.NOT_OBSERVED: the report was not truncated, or membership was established, and the address is still unconfirmed

amendment2_addressTruncation.rule: ADDRESS_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN is not NOT_OBSERVED and is not evidence that a game event is absent: it is a limit of the observing instrument
